name: Dynamic Cross-Platform Budget Allocation & Rebalancing
purpose: Analyze marginal efficiency across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads to intelligently shift budget towards the highest performing channels while respecting industry template floors.
triggerConditions: One platform experiencing significant CPA inflation while another outperforms
User prompt requesting cross-platform budget review
prerequisites: At least 2 active advertising platforms with live spend
Last 14 days of synchronized conversion and spend data
Client monthly budget cap and platform split limits defined

executionSteps.name: Extract Platform Marginal ROAS & CPA
executionSteps.action: Calculate marginal CPA and marginal ROAS across Google, Meta, and TikTok over the past 14 days

executionSteps.name: Model Cross-Channel Reallocation Matrix
executionSteps.action: Model budget shift (e.g. shift 10% from lower-efficiency channel to higher-efficiency channel) staying within template min/max ranges

executionSteps.name: Verify Platform Minimum Baseline Floors
executionSteps.action: Ensure no platform budget is cut below its minimum viability threshold (e.g. Google Search brand capture must not be defunded)

executionSteps.name: Human Approval Gate
executionSteps.action: Present proposed reallocation table (Current Budget vs Proposed Budget) for user approval

executionSteps.name: Execute Staggered Budget Rebalance
executionSteps.action: Apply new daily budgets across platform adapters in a staggered manner over 48 hours

successCriteria: Blended account ROAS improves by >= 10% within 14 days of rebalance
No channel drops below its designated minimum exploratory budget
Total combined spend matches exactly the approved monthly budget target

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry platform budget adjustment once; abort if total spend would exceed master cap

rollbackStrategy: Restore original platform budget split ratios immediately if blended CAC increases over 3 consecutive days.
